source.title: Buffo
source.rights_note: Copyright-restricted source art is evidence only; output contains no source pixels, palette, contours, layout, tracing, choreography, redistribution, close imitation, or Drew work.

history.visible_defect: The first actual 38-frame render ended with A too upright; the final state retained metadata debt but visually approached a neutral reset.
history.correction: Mutate C013-K12 itself: pitch head/shoulder forward of pelvis at the displaced throw-side address, trail the free hand high/back, keep the throwing hand low/right, widen the staggered base, then rerender the SAME Contact013.

history.visible_result: Final decoded render preserves a pronounced diagonal recovery-debt silhouette after payload settle; acquisition is bent-arm and pre-farthest-reach; rear-root pin visibly survives carry/load; LOAD_MAX and held release threshold are distinct; release is isolated at K7; payload cannot lead independently before K7; post-release body recoil, payload lead, body overshoot, object bounce, secondary lag and displaced settle read as separate phases.

noodle_queen.taste: PASS: the cross-body carry into ugly rear-loaded spring, long held threshold, and sharply divergent post-release clocks give the throw a specific authored attitude rather than polite object carrying.
noodle_queen.function: PASS: @ custody seam, # root pin, payload state, support ownership and explicit K7 release fork remain visible causal facts; object independence begins only after release.
noodle_queen.contempt: PASS: the specimen refuses mannequin symmetry, cheap farthest-reach contact, reverse recoil and neutral-reset recovery; the final diagonal debt and small payload rebound keep consequence on screen.

contract.full_repo_boundary: This Standard Chat does not use a local repository checkout as proof; official candidate test is executed against an isolated candidate-shaped tree and persistence is proven only by GitHub readback.
